dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body maximum width toward the posterior peduncle, following a smooth parabolic curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the sunlit dorsal surface, categorized as a fully depigmented adult canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast linear striations distributed across the anterior-mid dorsal plane; single small, dark focal pit visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct longitudinal dorsal ridge creating a sharp contrast and shadow boundary; minor superficial transverse skin folds visible on the anterior sunlit flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Shallow, healed linear marks (rake marks) concentrated on the anterior dorsal region.
